noemi: Quick a11y pass on the Alerts Center prototype. Noted a few consistent problems: focus ring missing on alert cards in Chrome, small meta text (11px) fails contrast in light theme, and screen readers sometimes announce the same alert twice when it appears. ben: thanks, can you add repro steps? noemi: repro: Chrome 117 mac + VoiceOver and Windows Chrome + NVDA. Steps: 1) open Alerts > Center (beta); 2) tab through alert cards; focus lands but no visible indicator; 3) trigger a new alert from the demo injector -> VO reads the alert header then reads the header again; 4) inspect meta timestamp text, it's 11px #6b7280 on #ffffff. tara: i reproduced the double announce. looks like we mount an alert element and also update a parent live region. both have aria-live. duplicates cause repeated announces. also the focus missing is because of a global reset setting outline: none on .card. ben: plan: (A) remove outline:none and add :focus-visible with token --a11y-focus; (B) consolidate live updates to a single sr-only container and replace its textContent (not append); (C) bump timestamp color to --muted-strong or increase size to 12px. sample code for live region: ```html
``` and JS: ```js const live = document.getElementById('alerts-live'); live.textContent = `New alert: ${title}`; // replace only ``` noemi: for focus: use :focus-visible with box-shadow so it isn't clipped by overflow. example: ```css .card:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--a11y-focus); outline: none; } ``` keep it rounded to match card radius. sam: product note: Alerts Center needs to be keyboard-friendly since customers triage from keyboard. prioritize the focus fix in the next patch. meta color change can be a design polish. tara: i'll run VO/NVDA quick checks on the preview. also adding an automated a11y smoke that tabs through the first 6 cards and asserts focus-visible computed style present. a11y-bot: scan results (axe-core): violations -> color-contrast x1, focus-visible-missing x1, duplicate-live-region x1. Recommended: single live region, visible focus styles, and stronger muted token. ben: i'll open a PR today with the three small changes + before/after screenshots and repro steps. noemi: thanks! small changes, big win for keyboard users. :raised_hands:
